script_contents.pull-pg-images.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
export DOCKER_CONFIG="/workspace/agenteam-dependency-recovery-5drj88a2/docker-config"
export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///var/run/docker.sock
unset DOCKER_AUTH_CONFIG DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH
for image in pgvector/pgvector@sha256:99a149d3c84cfb0f32d8da7d72737e4643468787220af2223418730f8e9e9cdc pgvector/pgvector@sha256:16e62164a405447dca191079a924ee5b8a9dbf04fe53128701ffbea857b37782
do
  digest="${image##*:}"
  printf 'command: timeout 180 docker --config %s --host unix:///var/run/docker.sock pull %s
' "$DOCKER_CONFIG" "$image"
  timeout 180 docker --config "$DOCKER_CONFIG" --host unix:///var/run/docker.sock pull "$image" > "/workspace/agenteam-dependency-recovery-5drj88a2/logs/pull-$digest.log" 2>&1
  status=$?
  printf 'pull_exit=%s image=%s
' "$status" "$image"
  cat "/workspace/agenteam-dependency-recovery-5drj88a2/logs/pull-$digest.log"
  printf '%s
' "$status" > "/workspace/agenteam-dependency-recovery-5drj88a2/logs/pull-$digest.exit"
done
script_contents.download-minio.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. "/workspace/agenteam-dependency-recovery-5drj88a2/environment.sh"
cd "$research_dir"
test "$("$research_go" env GOVERSION)" = go1.27.1
"$research_go" version > "$research_dir/logs/go-version.txt"
"$research_go" env GOTOOLCHAIN GOENV GOWORK GOPROXY GOSUMDB GOPRIVATE GONOPROXY GONOSUMDB GOMODCACHE GOPATH GOCACHE GOOS GOARCH GOAMD64 CGO_ENABLED > "$research_dir/logs/go-environment.txt"
"$research_go" mod download -json github.com/minio/minio@v0.0.0-20251015172955-9e49d5e7a648 > "$research_dir/server-source.json" 2> "$research_dir/logs/server-source.stderr"
script_contents.download-root-dependencies.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. /workspace/agenteam-dependency-recovery-5drj88a2/environment.sh
export GOMODCACHE=/workspace/agenteam-dependency-cache/modcache
export GOCACHE=/workspace/agenteam-dependency-cache/gocache
export GOPATH=/workspace/agenteam-dependency-cache/gopath
export GOTMPDIR=/workspace/agenteam-dependency-cache/gotmp
cd /workspace/agenteam-dependency-cache/root-module
sha256sum go.mod go.sum > "$research_dir/logs/root-module-before.sha256"
"$research_go" mod download -json all > "$research_dir/logs/root-download.json" 2> "$research_dir/logs/root-download.stderr"
"$research_go" mod verify > "$research_dir/logs/root-verify.log" 2>&1
sha256sum -c "$research_dir/logs/root-module-before.sha256"

script_contents.build-minio.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. /workspace/agenteam-dependency-recovery-5drj88a2/environment.sh
cd "$GOMODCACHE/github.com/minio/minio@v0.0.0-20251015172955-9e49d5e7a648"
"$research_go" build -mod=readonly -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags '-s -w -X github.com/minio/minio/cmd.Version=2025-10-15T17:29:55Z -X github.com/minio/minio/cmd.ReleaseTag=RELEASE.2025-10-15T17-29-55Z -X github.com/minio/minio/cmd.CommitID=9e49d5e7a648f00e26f2246f4dc28e6b07f8c84a -X github.com/minio/minio/cmd.ShortCommitID=9e49d5e7a648 -X github.com/minio/minio/cmd.CopyrightYear=2025' -o "$research_dir/bin/minio" . > "$research_dir/logs/server-build.log" 2>&1
sha256sum "$research_dir/bin/minio" go.mod go.sum > "$research_dir/logs/server-build.sha256"
printf '%s  %s\n' dc5298474f0bc87a068f0b1135c583bb1278c17c11c512212ed7644a238c89c8 "$research_dir/bin/minio" | sha256sum -c - > "$research_dir/logs/server-binary-match.log" 2>&1
"$research_dir/bin/minio" --version > "$research_dir/logs/server-version.log" 2>&1
"$research_go" version -m "$research_dir/bin/minio" > "$research_dir/logs/server-buildinfo.log" 2>&1
